name: Live Activities
description: Your iPhone's Live Activities on the Car Thing, mirrored from your Mac and redrawn natively. The Car Thing must be plugged into a Mac on macOS 26 over USB, and the bridgething desktop app needs Full Disk Access.

data.label: Bring Live Activities to the front
data.description: When the Car Thing switches to this app on its own. It goes back to the previous app when the last activity ends.
